{{Top|leg}}
The '''Teguta Lusat Port Authority''' was the administrative body for the principal [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]]. It was located just outside the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Teguta Lusat]], on [[Rafa IV]]. The authority's duties included governing all air traffic, issuing landing permits, and granting lift-off permission. Ground Control was a sub-division of the port authority and was charged with ground-traffic control, the loading and unloading of cargo, planetary quarantines, etc. A [[Portmaster/Legends|portmaster]] was overseer of the installation.<ref name="sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
